mapper.select: SELECT /* AuthMapper.selectLoginAccount 로그인 계정 */ L.MB_ID , M.MB_NM , L.EMP_CD , E.EMP_NM , L.LOGIN_ID , L.USER_PWD , L.ACCT_LOCK_TYPE FROM TBSY_LOGIN L JOIN TBSY_MEMBER M ON M.MB_ID = L.MB_ID AND M.USE_YN = 'Y' LEFT OUTER JOIN TBIN_EMPMST E ON E.MB_ID = L.MB_ID AND E.EMP_CD = L.EMP_CD WHERE L.MB_ID = #{mbId} AND L.LOGIN_ID = #{loginId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBSY_LOGIN_HIST /* AuthMapper.insertLoginHist 로그인 이력 */ (MB_ID, EMP_CD, LOGIN_IP, LOGIN_DTM) VALUES (#{mbId}, #{empCd}, #{loginIp}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT /* AuthMapper.selectMenuList 메뉴 (상위 메뉴 정렬 -> 하위 메뉴 정렬) */ R.RESOURCE_ID AS MENU_ID , R.PRNT_RESOURCE_ID AS PRNT_MENU_ID , R.RESOURCE_NAME AS MENU_NM , R.RESOURCE_URL AS MENU_URL , CASE WHEN R.PRNT_RESOURCE_ID IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS MENU_LVL FROM TBSY_RESOURCE R LEFT OUTER JOIN TBSY_RESOURCE P ON P.MB_ID = R.MB_ID AND P.RESOURCE_ID = R.PRNT_RESOURCE_ID WHERE R.MB_ID = #{mbId} AND R.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY IFNULL(P.SORT_NO, R.SORT_NO) , IFNULL(R.PRNT_RESOURCE_ID, R.RESOURCE_ID) , CASE WHEN R.PRNT_RESOURCE_ID IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END , R.SORT_NO
